gaps.lead: Her French improved because she spent years in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.
gaps.explanation: as a result of + noun/-ing = because of.

gaps.lead: Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.
gaps.explanation: nobody runs faster = she is the fastest runner.

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.answer: as close to the beach as
gaps.lead: The hotel was further from the beach than we expected.
gaps.explanation: further than expected = not as close (to the beach) as expected.

gaps.lead: 'I'll definitely call you when I land,' she told me.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call; the person promised shifts to 'me'.

gaps.lead: People claim that this herbal tea cures colds.
gaps.explanation: X is claimed to + infinitive = people claim X does.
